# Claude Daily Memory

Claude Daily Memory makes NotebookLM the persistent memory for Claude Code. One installation collects privacy-filtered daily outcomes, appends them idempotently to one growing Google Doc, automatically refreshes that source in one permanent NotebookLM notebook, and registers a full local NotebookLM MCP so Claude can use all notebooks and materials in the account.

Canonical website: https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/
Russian website: https://geft1310-hue.github.io/claude-daily-memory/ru/
Repository: https://github.com/geft1310-hue/claude-daily-memory
Version: 0.2.0
License: Apache-2.0
Language: Python 3.11+

## Core facts

- One installer and one environment: `~/.local/share/claude-daily-memory/venv`.
- One unified setup handles Google OAuth, Google Doc creation/reuse, local NotebookLM login, permanent notebook/source binding, local stdio MCP registration, Gemini keyring setup, initial source refresh, and timer enablement.
- Daily state advances only after both Google append and NotebookLM refresh succeed.
- Claude can use all NotebookLM notebooks, sources, grounded chat, notes, research, Studio artifacts, downloads, and sharing available through the pinned MCP.
- Deletion and sharing expansion require preview and separate explicit confirmation.
- Raw Claude transcripts, full prompts/responses, commands, tool data, Gmail, arbitrary project files, and NotebookLM answers are not automatic memory sources.
- Every selected artifact and the final digest are scanned before networking; uncertainty fails closed.
- Google Drive/Docs use official APIs with `drive.file`; refresh tokens and the Gemini API key live in the OS keyring.
- NotebookLM uses pinned `notebooklm-py[browser,mcp]==0.8.0`, local browser state, and local `stdio`; no remote HTTP MCP, master token, `NOTEBOOKLM_AUTH_JSON`, or cloud cookie transfer.
- The NotebookLM dependency uses internal Google web RPCs and may require an update or renewed login when Google changes them.
